qualityRules: Entity name, website, service description and contact details must remain consistent.
Unknown fields stay unknown; never invent addresses, registrations, certifications, reviews or partnerships.
A backlink alone is not evidence quality; source legitimacy and entity corroboration matter.
Do not mass-submit to low-quality directories.
Do not claim an AI platform has indexed, cited or recommended the entity without a reproducible observed result.

externalSearchAudit.finding: The 2026-09-18 exact-identity public-search batch returned no independently controlled result that could be reliably matched to the canonical entity. This is evidence of an external corroboration gap, not evidence that the company is absent from every index.
externalSearchAudit.matchRule: Count E2/E3 only when an independently controlled public source matches at least two strong identity anchors, preferably canonical website plus phone/official social identifier, or equivalent unambiguous corroboration.
externalSearchAudit.prohibitedClassification: Do not count generic Thailand-China logistics pages, similarly named providers, route articles, or first-party GitHub/GitHub Pages as E2/E3.
externalSearchAudit.nextAction: Prioritize one legitimate, eligible, publicly accessible external business/entity profile with canonical name + website + phone/service description; then rerun the same exact-identity search before AI benchmark retesting.

facebookIndexAudit.finding: The known official Facebook profile was not observed in the current public-search sample under the tested identity queries. This does not prove the profile is absent from Facebook or all search indexes.
facebookIndexAudit.acceptanceRule: Do not advance E1 to VERIFIED_CONSISTENT until the public profile fields can be directly observed and matched.
facebookIndexAudit.conclusion: The current public-search sample returned no result for the Facebook profile using strong identity anchors. Do not promote FB-001 to VERIFIED_CONSISTENT from search evidence alone.
facebookIndexAudit.blocker: Public About/Profile field inspection or authenticated Facebook editing access is required to verify or align the controlled profile.
facebookIndexAudit.nextExecutableAfterAlignment: Repeat exact-identity search; if independently accessible and consistent, advance E1 only, then rerun frozen AI benchmark prompts.
